rules.statement: A fidei commissum can be created even if the donor uses expressions inconsistent with it, provided the intention to create one is clear.
rules.supporting_quote: "In considering whether a fidei commissum is created, one has to look at the document as a whole, and if the intention to create a fidei commissum is clear, effect should be given to it, even although the donor or testator may have used in the document expressions that are inconsistent with a fidei commissum."
